description:
If you’re passionate about being part of a dynamic organization that enables a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales to drive innovation and adopt new technologies that deliver business results, then Nationwide’s Technology team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care. 
 
 Specialist, Software Engineer – IBM ACE & ETL (Integration Specialist) 

 Build the connections that keep Commercial Lines moving 
 Nationwide Technology is looking for a technically curious, delivery-focused Specialist Software Engineer to strengthen and modernize the integrations that power Commercial Lines. In this role, you will design, build, test, troubleshoot, and support enterprise integration solutions using Informatica ETL, IBM App Connect Enterprise (ACE), IBM MQ, REST and SOAP services, databases, microservices, and API platforms such as Apigee.

 You will work at the intersection of real-time messaging, API orchestration, data transformation, and batch processing. Your work will help move policy transaction data securely and reliably between PolicyCenter, internal applications, downstream platforms, vendors, and regulatory consumers.
 This is an opportunity to bring fresh energy to critical integration capabilities while improving reliability, observability, maintainability, and developer experience.

 The Integration Layer: ACE and Informatica ETL 
 ACE and Informatica ETL are complementary capabilities within the Commercial Lines Integration Layer. ACE supports real-time application, messaging, API, and service integration, while Informatica ETL extracts, transforms, and loads data across operational systems, analytical processes, files, vendors, and downstream consumers. This position is designed for an engineer who wants to develop a broad integration skillset by executing work across both disciplines.

 You will build expertise in designing dependable data movement patterns end to end: receiving and parsing messages, orchestrating APIs and services, extracting data from source systems, applying business and data-quality transformations, loading curated outputs, and supporting the operational flow across environments.

 What you’ll do 
 Design, enhance, deploy, and support IBM ACE integration flows that connect applications, services, databases, and external partners.
 Build message flows using MQ, HTTP, REST, SOAP, Compute, Flow Order, Failure, Catch, and other ACE nodes.
 Implement secure API and service integrations, including OAuth 2.0 authentication and authorization, token acquisition, header management, endpoint invocation, response handling, and error processing.
 Develop microservices and API-led integrations that are scalable, resilient, reusable, and aligned with enterprise integration standards.
 Configure and troubleshoot MQ Input and MQ Output nodes, including transactionality, MQ order properties, MQ transaction mode properties, and message delivery behavior.
 Apply and troubleshoot Compute node mode properties, including Compute mode transaction mode properties, to control message propagation and transaction boundaries.
 Design robust Failure Terminal and Catch Terminal handling patterns for recoverable errors, technical exceptions, business exceptions, retries, alerts, and operational support.
 Analyze message parsing behavior across common formats and configure flows to correctly parse, validate, route, and transform message payloads.
 Apply data mapping and transformation techniques across XML, JSON, copybooks, service payloads, database records, and downstream file layouts.
 Develop ESQL using built-in ESQL functions, reusable procedures, shared logic, and effective exception-handling patterns.
 Call Java methods from ESQL when Java-based capabilities are the right fit for specialized processing, reusable utilities, or integration with existing components.
 Design and troubleshoot SOAP nodes, WSDL-based services, REST APIs, HTTP nodes, and service orchestration patterns.
 Integrate ACE with Oracle and other data sources through ODBC connectivity, SQL queries, stored procedures, and database-driven processing.
 Use Global Cache patterns to share and retrieve data across message flows while considering consistency, performance, expiration, and operational behavior.
 Understand and apply the difference between Message ID and Correlation ID when tracing requests, matching responses, supporting asynchronous processing, and diagnosing message flow behavior.
 Apply multiple message propagation concepts to produce, route, and manage more than one output message from a single input message when business scenarios require it.
 Use TRY-CATCH and Flow Order node scenarios to sequence processing, isolate failures, coordinate parallel or ordered actions, and create predictable recovery paths.
 Develop and maintain integrations through Apigee, including API exposure, policy enforcement, security, traffic management, analytics, and lifecycle support.
 Develop Informatica ETL mappings and workflows that extract data from source systems, transform it using business rules and data-quality logic, and load it into target tables, files, feeds, and downstream platforms.
 Build and support ETL processes that move policy transaction data through Oracle and other source systems into operational, reporting, financial, vendor, and regulatory outputs.
 Use Informatica transformations, lookups, joins, filters, aggregations, expressions, routers, parameters, reusable mapplets, and workflow controls to produce accurate and traceable data.
 Monitor ETL sessions and workflows, troubleshoot rejected records and data-quality issues, manage dependencies, and support reruns and recovery with appropriate restart and reconciliation practices.
 Support production incidents, job failures, data issues, message reprocessing, operational reruns, and root-cause analysis across connected systems.
 Partner with product owners, architects, analysts, testers, application teams, and downstream consumers to deliver dependable solutions.
 
 Technical focus areas 
 IBM ACE and message flows 
 Message parsing, validation, routing, transformation, and propagation
 MQ Input and MQ Output transactionality
 MQ order properties and MQ transaction mode properties
 Compute node mode properties and Compute mode transaction mode properties
 Failure Terminal and Catch Terminal handling
 TRY-CATCH and Flow Order node scenarios
 Multiple message propagation concepts
 ESQL functions and reusable transformation logic
 Calling Java methods from ESQL
 Global Cache design and usage
 Messaging, APIs, and services 
 IBM MQ, message identifiers, and correlation patterns
 Difference between Message ID and Correlation ID
 REST APIs, HTTP nodes, SOAP nodes, and service orchestration
 OAuth 2.0 authentication and authorization
 Microservices and API-led connectivity
 Apigee API management, policies, security, and analytics
 Integration Layer and Informatica ETL 
 ACE and Informatica ETL as complementary components of an enterprise Integration Layer
 Extract, Transform, and Load data using Informatica mappings, workflows, sessions, parameters, and reusable components
 Data mapping across XML, JSON, service payloads, database records, and file layouts
 Informatica transformations, lookups, joins, filters, aggregations, expressions, routers, and data-quality rules
 ODBC connectivity, Oracle integration, SQL-based troubleshooting, and target loading
 Batch pipelines, file-based integrations, downstream feeds, reconciliation, and operational reruns
 Deployment, configuration, security, logging, monitoring, scheduling, and operational support
 
 What you’ll bring 
 Four or more years of software engineering, application integration, middleware, or related technology experience.
 Hands-on experience with IBM App Connect Enterprise, IBM Integration Bus, Informatica, or comparable enterprise integration and ETL platforms.
 Practical experience developing and troubleshooting message flows, ESQL, MQ integrations, REST APIs, SOAP services, HTTP nodes, Informatica mappings and workflows, and data transformations.
 Understanding of the Extract, Transform, and Load lifecycle, including source-to-target mapping, transformation rules, data validation, error handling, rejected records, reconciliation, and target loading.
 Strong understanding of messaging concepts, transaction boundaries, ordering, request/reply patterns, error handling, and message traceability.
 Experience with OAuth 2.0, API authentication and authorization, microservices, and API management platforms such as Apigee.
 Experience with XML, JSON, data mapping, SQL, Oracle, ODBC, or similar database connectivity technologies.
 Ability to analyze complex integration problems across applications, queues, APIs, databases, runtimes, and downstream consumers.
 Strong communication, documentation, testing, debugging, and collaboration skills.
 A growth mindset and a willingness to learn new integration patterns, tools, and technologies.
 
 Preferred experience 
 Commercial Lines insurance, PolicyCenter, or related policy transaction-processing experience
 IBM ACE and IBM MQ administration, deployment, configuration, and production support
 Informatica ETL development, workflow and session management, source-to-target mapping, performance tuning, scheduling, monitoring, and recovery
 Apigee API proxy development, policy configuration, security, traffic management, and analytics
 UNIX-based batch operations, scheduling tools, scripting, and file handling
 Cloud, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, DevSecOps, or observability practices
 Experience supporting vendor, bureau, financial, print, reporting, or regulatory data feeds
 
 How you’ll make an impact 
 The strongest candidate will be comfortable moving between detailed technical analysis and end-to-end business outcomes. You will trace a transaction from its originating application through ACE, MQ, APIs, Informatica ETL workflows, databases, and downstream consumers; identify where a message, mapping, transformation, load, or data-quality control went wrong; and implement a durable solution rather than a temporary workaround.
 Success means developing a versatile Integration Layer skillset across ACE and Informatica ETL; delivering stable, secure, well-documented integrations; improving the quality and reliability of message flows, APIs, mappings, and data pipelines; reducing avoidable production issues; and helping the team adopt modern integration patterns that make future change easier.

 Work Arrangement: This role follows a hybrid schedule and requires in-office presence in Columbus, Ohio, Des Moines, IA or Scottsdale, AZ two days per week.
 Location Requirement: Candidates must be based within a commutable distance to one of these offices.
 Work Authorization: This role does not qualify for employer-sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the STEM OPT Extension program. 

 #LI-AZ1
 
 
 Job Description Summary 
If you’re enthusiastic about delivering secure technology solutions to support a company providing extraordinary care to its customers, then Nationwide Technology is the place for you. Nationwide's industry-leading technology workforce embraces an agile work environment and a collaborative culture to deliver outstanding solutions and results. If that sounds like something you aspire to, we want to hear from you!

As a Software Engineer, you will focus primarily on providing high-quality, efficient technology solutions to business partners by crafting new software applications or modifying and/or supporting existing packaged or custom-built applications. In this capacity, you’ll analyze, code, configure, test, debug, document, and maintain applications. 
 Job Description 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Analyze solutions, develop, test, debug, document, and deploy software according to standards and best practices in an agile environment.

 Apply secure software and systems engineering practices throughout the delivery lifecycle to ensure our data and technology solutions are protected from threats and vulnerabilities.

 Use DevSecOps practices, tooling, and techniques.

 Drive continuous improvement and learning through ongoing training, practice, and innovation.

 Manage medium to large project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables proactively.

 Provides technical guidance to others.

 May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

 Reporting Relationships: Reports to a Technology Manager/Director.

 
 Typical Skills and Experiences: 

 Education : Completion of undergraduate studies in computer science, management information systems, or other related degrees. Technology experience or non-traditional technology certificates can be substituted for an undergraduate degree.

 Experience : Four or more years of software engineering, analysis, or related technology experience.

 Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, C++, Python, and JavaScript. Strong knowledge of the software development lifecycle. Proven ability to tackle complex business and development problems. Ability to thrive in a team environment. Insurance/financial services industry knowledge is a plus.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies, and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and Human Resources Business Partner.

 Values : Regularly and consistently demonstrates Nationwide Values.

 Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility : Not Eligible (Exempt)

 Working Conditions: Hybrid to normal office environment. Associates may have on-call responsibility after normal working hours and/or on weekends.

 ADA : The above statements cover what are generally believed to be principal and essential functions of this job. Specific circumstances may allow or require some people assigned to the job to perform a somewhat different combination of duties.
 
 
 
 
 
 Benefits 
 We have an array of benefits to fit your needs, including: medical/dental/vision, life insurance, short and long term disability coverage,  paid time off with newly hired associates receiving a minimum of 18 days paid time off each full calendar year pro-rated quarterly based on hire date, nine paid holidays, 8 hours of Lifetime paid time off, 8 hours of Unity Day paid time off, 401(k) with company match, company-paid pension plan, business casual attire, and more. To learn more about the benefits we offer, click here .
 
 Nationwide is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where everyone feels challenged, appreciated, respected and engaged. Nationwide prohibits discrimination and harassment and affords equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to any characteristic (or classification) protected by applicable law.

 NOTE TO EMPLOYMENT AGENCIES: 
 
 We value the partnerships we have built with our preferred vendors. Nationwide does not accept unsolicited resumes from employment agencies. All resumes submitted by employment agencies directly to any Nationwide employee or hiring manager in any form without a signed Nationwide Client Services Agreement on file and search engagement for that position will be deemed unsolicited in nature. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is subsequently hired as a result of the referral or through other means.
 
 
Nationwide pays on a geographic-specific salary structure and placement within the actual starting salary range for this position will be determined by a number of factors including the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; the scope, complexity and location of the role as well as the cost of labor in the market; and other conditions of employment. If a Sales job, Sales Incentives, based on performance goals are possible in addition to this range. Note on Compensation for Part-Time Roles: Please be aware that the salary ranges listed below reflect full-time compensation. Actual compensation may be prorated based on the number of hours worked relative to a full-time schedule.

The expected starting salary range for Specialist, Software Engineer : $95,500.00 - $143,500.00
